title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, technology impacts everything we do. Our digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. By digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a difference to countless lives. Your dedication and hard work will be instrumental in helping Pfizer achieve new milestones and make a positive impact on patients worldwide. ROLE SUMMARY Build AI that Finance & Global Business Services (GBS) teams use every day and see it in production within weeks. As Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, you join a Finance & GBS function team, learn how the work gets done, and build AI that changes it. You own the full path: problem discovery, prototype, MVP, production handoff and support. You learn the process, and you write the code. You work on engagements in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury, shared services operations, and other F&GBS functions. We measure success through adoption and demonstrable business outcomes, including time saved and adoption, improved quality, reduced risk, stronger controls, faster cycle times, better decisions, and measurable financial impact. This is a hands-on individual contributor role within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center in Chennai. You work alongside Product Owners, function leaders, finance analysts, process owners, and Digital platform teams. WHY THIS ROLE You work directly with Finance and GBS teams worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You build agentic AI with frontier models on Pfizer’s enterprise AI platforms, connected to SAP, Snowflake, Oracle EPM and custom solutions through MCP or direct API integration. You help build and expand a shared F&GBS Data & AI Foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library, and decision ledger), so future agents don’t start from scratch. You can grow into a Senior Manager technical lead role without moving into people management. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Problem Discovery & Business Embedding Work in person in Chennai alongside a F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with an assigned Finance or GBS team. Learn the work through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, map the process, and find where AI removes effort, risk, or delay. Run discovery with business users and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Translate business pain points into scoped use cases with success measures agreed with the business owner. Work from Product Owner priorities and specifications, and shape them into buildable scope with the business owner. Push back when the request doesn’t match the underlying problem or it’s exposed to technical issues and limitation. Build & Ship Build agentic AI solutions end to end: agents and tools on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, other market leading runtimes and Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph, LangChain, MCP tool integrations, retrieval with Azure AI Search, document extraction with Document Intelligence, and the interfaces users touch. Deliver working prototypes in days and MVPs in weeks. Iterate directly with end users. Write production-quality code in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, with tests, version control, and code review. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow, and review AI-generated code to the same standard as your own. Build evaluation sets that prove accuracy on real finance data before release, and run them as regression tests on every change. Data & Enterprise Integration Connect solutions to enterprise Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools (or API) and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Write and tune SQL. Use and extend the shared F&GBS ontology, semantic views, and business rules instead of hard-coding logic in prompts. Follow data access, entitlement, and classification rules for financial and personal data. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI Design solutions that hold up to SOX, Internal Audit, data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act), and EU AI Act review. Record agent evidence, approvals, and actions in the decision ledger, and build human review steps where AI outputs drive financial decisions. Apply Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, and output monitoring. Document design decisions, data lineage, and model behavior for control owners. Production & Handoff Own production readiness and ongoing support: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Deploy through approved pipelines on Pfizer cloud and GenAI platforms. Set up logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Contribute reusable components and patterns to the team’s shared library. Value & Adoption Track usage, accuracy, and hours saved. Report results to the business owner and FDE leadership. Train users and build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with [6+] years of software or data engineering experience. 3+ years building LLM-based applications, including RAG, tool calling, or agents, with at least one solution in use by business users. Experience evaluating and testing LLM output quality. Hands-on Python coding at a production standard. Working knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern web framework such as React. Strong SQL and experience working with enterprise data platforms. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud services, API design, and CI/CD. Track record of working directly with business users to define and deliver solutions. Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Working knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, or FP&A. Experience with SAP data structures, Snowflake (including Cortex), or the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML). Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph), MCP, and vector search. Exposure to ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. Experience in a regulated industry, with exposure to SOX or IT general controls. Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Developer or Solutions Architect or other market leading runtimes). You don’t need every item on this list. If you’ve shipped AI that people use and you want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL, OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Regular overlap with US and European time zones is required, including some early-evening IST calls. Must be able to travel to Pfizer offices and partner sites when required, including occasional international travel. Work can be demanding at times, including support during period-end close or response to production incidents.
